hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' <<< "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"); case "$f" in *.rs) rustfmt --edition 2021 "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' <<< "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"); case "$f" in */crates/*.rs|crates/*.rs) crate=$(echo "$f" | sed -nE 's|.*crates/([^/]+)/.*|\1|p'); if [ -n "$crate" ]; then cd /Volumes/Projects/spur && cargo check -p "$crate" --message-format=short 2>&1 | tail -20; fi ;; esac
